calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(join_date), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH per AS (
  SELECT member_id,
         count(*) AS versions,
         sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows,
         sum(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_rows,
         max(valid_from) AS last_from
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT current_rows, open_rows, count(*) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM per GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
